name: retro-tv
title: Retro TV — glowing figures on a dark field
status_note: Visual direction only (2026-11-11): the writer gets this brief, but painted bases, the host cut-out, inserts and props exist only for cozy, and the compositor has no CRT pass yet, so a render still uses the cozy art. Painting this pack's library and adding the television pass come before a retro-tv video.

reference.note: Visual direction adapted from kaomei/stickman-video-director (MIT), style B3 Retro TV. Our own rig, painting and compositor; only the look is adapted. See docs/KAOMEI_INTEGRATION.md.

cast.description: the host: a refined white figure with a blank circular head and rounded joints, glowing softly on the dark
a second figure in light gray, same build, so the two read apart on the dark field

palette.field: a deep dark charcoal field with generous negative space
palette.figures: white and soft gray silhouettes with gray overlap detail

accents.signal red: the one accent: a warning, a strike-through, the moment something goes wrong

palette.rule: one red accent at most, used sparingly; a gentle explainer may not need it at all

television.signal_breaks: brief interruptions as accents on a story beat, never a constant glitch
television.note: Applied once over the finished composition, after the clean animation reads on its own.

text.captions: white uppercase sans-serif captions near the bottom, no label behind them

voice.note: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), read at its native speed.

audio.note: A quiet ambient bed under the voice (the compositor's soft bed, ducked). Signal noise is an accent, never the soundtrack.

pacing.note: Kokoro's measured rate, as for cozy.

writer_note: Style retro-tv: white and gray glowing figures with blank round heads on a dark field, simple clear objects, lots of empty dark space, a restrained old-television finish. Describe scenes as a few white-line objects on the dark; use the one red accent only when something goes wrong; framed screen-in-screen inserts and progressive line diagrams suit this look.
